system.description:
By touching a living subject, the Cappadocian induces a "near-death experience": a nonfatal heart seizure, sudden inability to draw breath, or another disastrous physiological event. The experience is nonlethal but often affects the victim profoundly, and callous Cappadocians have been known to use it to bully mortals into obedience.

System: The vampire must touch her target and spend a Blood Trait, then win a Mental Challenge (retest with Medicine) against the target's Willpower. The degree of the victory determines how profoundly the target is affected, from slight discomfort to a massive, scarring coronary episode. This power affects only the living; vampires are unharmed by it (except on a botch, which incapacitates the Cappadocian with visions of her own gruesome Final Death for the remainder of the scene).
system.source: Clanbook: Cappadocian, Chapter Three: Observations and Conclusions
